title: Antipodal Parity Refinement of the Sperner Door-Counting Engine (the Tucker Frontier)
description: Isolates, at the abstract cell-complex level of the sperner-mathlib engine, the exact parity obstruction for deriving Tucker’s lemma from Sperner door-counting. The antipodal map is a fixed-point-free involution on boundary doors, so the raw antipodal boundary-door count is even (even_card_boundary_doors_of_antipodal), hence the panchromatic count is even (even_card_panchromatic_of_antipodal) and can never supply the odd parity exists_panchromatic requires (not_odd_panchromatic_of_antipodal). Dimension-free; sharpens what the remaining geometric input for Tucker must be. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
